definitions.explanation: Showing careful and persistent effort in one's work or duties.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{勤勉|きんべん}な{学生|がくせい}だ。
{勤勉|きんべん}に{働|はたら}くことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{日本人|にほんじん}は{勤勉|きんべん}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japanese people are said to be hardworking.

notes:
{勤勉|きんべん} describes consistent, dedicated effort in work or study. It is a na-adjective that carries a more formal, literary tone than everyday words like {真面目|まじめ}.

FORMS:
- {勤勉|きんべん}な + noun: diligent ~ (modifier)
- {勤勉|きんべん}に + verb: diligently ~ (adverbial)
- {勤勉|きんべん}さ: diligence (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勤勉|きんべん}な{学生|がくせい}: diligent student
- {勤勉|きんべん}な{国民|こくみん}: hardworking people/nation
- {勤勉|きんべん}に{働|はたら}く: to work diligently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真面目|まじめ}: serious, earnest (broader — covers attitude, not just effort)
- {熱心|ねっしん}: enthusiastic, zealous (emphasizes passion)
- {勤勉|きんべん}: diligent (emphasizes steady, consistent hard work)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. More commonly used in written language, speeches, and descriptions of national character than in everyday conversation.
